bonus.text: One account traces the couple dance m'bwiza to Malawians who had gone to South Africa. Its band pairs the accordion with a gong and an orchestra side drum.
Mwinoghe means "Let us enjoy ourselves". Men and women line up in two rows, twisting to three drums, a whistle and the leader's commands, with no singing.
In 2019, the Lilongwe Dance Program staged Malawi's first production of The Nutcracker, to sold-out audiences.
